# Seaport

> Seaport (Seaport Pte. Ltd., UEN 202619369N) is an international creative marketing company based in Singapore. It brings real customers to businesses using conventional and unconventional marketing: TikTok and Instagram creator videos, livestream marketing, and coupon deals handed out in person. Every view, coupon and visit is tracked. Tagline: Porting your brands.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: SMEs and corporates in Singapore, Southeast Asia and worldwide, including cafes, restaurants, salons, gyms, retail, fashion, tourism and attractions.
- Creator videos: short TikTok and Instagram videos by vetted local and international creators. Each video has its own offer code so the business sees the customers it brings in. Any video that gets under 1,000 views in 7 days is remade free.
- Livestream marketing: creators go live on TikTok with the brand on screen and a live offer code.
- Coupon deals: coupon deals handed out in person near the shop. Free for shops during launch; customers buy the coupon and redeem it at the shop.
- Process: brief and match (three vetted creators shortlisted, the business picks one), film and post (one round of changes), count and repeat (results report after 7 days).
- Plans: Trial, Starter, Micro Starter, Monthly, plus custom campaigns. Prices are quoted on request.
- Contact: team@getseaport.com, WhatsApp +65 8498 8225. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/getseaport/
